Leadville, Colorado · eat

Restaurants in Leadville for cyclists

Where to eat in Leadville the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Leadville Trail 100 MTB.

Restaurants in Leadville for cyclists, listed

  1. Tennessee Pass Cafe

    American cafe · 222 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    Organic, locally sourced menu with vegan and vegetarian options and a patio; the standard post-ride lunch

  2. High Mountain Pies

    Pizza · 115 W 4th St, Leadville, CO 80461

    Twenty-plus years of pizza a block off Harrison; open 11 am to 10 pm daily

  3. Treeline Kitchen

    New American · 615 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    Family-owned dinner spot, Wednesday-Sunday from 3:30 pm, with a seasonal rooftop bar it calls the highest in the country

  4. The Legendary Silver Dollar Saloon

    Saloon, pub food · 315 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    Open since 1879; a small in-house menu and a lot of history on the walls

  5. Buchi Cafe Cubano

    Cuban coffee and sandwiches · 401 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    Breakfast and lunch on Harrison; Cuban coffee and pressed sandwiches

  6. Quincy's Steak & Spirits

    Steakhouse · 416 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    Simple steak-and-spirits dinner on the main street
